gate_3_model_fixes.diagnosis: The 2B lane can produce a correct replace_function_body when given one function, one tool and one contract in isolation, but inside the loop it rewrites whole files and repeatedly tries to edit the read-only probe. The 3B coder lane emits valid single tool calls but degrades to malformed responses in the multi-turn loop. The 7B vision lane is not a coder. Blocked on lane capability, not harness.
